statements.t: There is no assurance that we will be profitable or obtain the funds necessary to finance our future operations.
The loss in revenues may result in a disruption in the Company’s cash flows limiting the ability to meet its obligations or investing in capital projects.

We re-evaluate our estimates and assumptions at least on a quarterly basis and periodically update the estimates used in the preparation of the financial statements based on management’s latest assessment of the current and projected business and general economic environment.
As noted below, our working capital is negative as of September 30, 2026, primarily from capital development projects that resulted in minimal to no increase in production.
Management continues to seek additional sources of capital via the debt or equity markets to improve liquidity going forward.

Any additional derivative financial instruments Empire may enter into or anticipated production increases from our ongoing development projects will further strengthen Empire’s cash flows from operations.

Investing activities for 2026 primarily relate to the Company’s gas development program in Texas which comprises the majority of the Company’s approximate $11.5 million cash spend compared to approximately $4.0 million in the prior period primarily associated with various projects in Texas and North Dakota.

Net oil sales volumes were approximately 114,000 Bbls for the three months ended September 30, 2026, a decrease over the same period in the prior year primarily due to natural decline and certain wells within North Dakota being down for our steam unit performance enhancement projects which began in the second quarter of 2026.
The higher workover expense in 2026 was primarily in North Dakota from the Company’s steam unit performance enhancements and general projects in New Mexico.
We also reclassified certain capitalized costs for projects in Texas which were reevaluated in the third quarter of 2026.

risks.t: Empire’s failure to secure short and long-term financing necessary to sustain and grow its operations
changes in the markets in which Empire participates
uncertainties associated with legal and regulatory matters
